main_body: raised wooden coop/shed with sloped plank roof
top_band: sloped wooden plank roof in tan and brown tones from row 1 to row 20
evidence: The structure clearly shows a 20-row sloped wooden roof (rows 1-20) with a front edge trim (rows 19-20) overhanging the vertical front wall (rows 22-34) which has a 1-row eave shadow at row 22, a recessed opening (rows 28-34), a base platform with its own top band at row 35, and support legs down to row 43.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, finely textured Beodeul reference buildings, the candidate uses flat geometric bands of solid brown for its planks with no wood grain or speckle, and relies on heavy near-black outlines around the roof, walls, door, and window.
